mentions.name: HeartRoutine
mentions.description: A heart-health tracking app where users enter their numbers in an offline app, configure goals such as lowering Apo B through diet and exercise, and then receive a server-sent email every morning asking what they ate and how they exercised, with the goal of staying on track and producing a detailed report to bring to a cardiologist.
mentions.problem: Helps stay on top of heart health and stay on track with goals like lowering Apo B through diet and exercise.
mentions.source_excerpt: HeartRoutine (https://www.heartroutine.com/) - I built this a few months ago to help me stay on top of my heart health.
